preconditions.name: harm_relief_channel_reachable
preconditions.description: A scripted movement sequence must produce at least one tick where HARM_RELIEF_GAIN * harm_relief clears GoalConfig.benefit_threshold, confirming the ablation's conflation channel is mechanically capable of firing before an organic result from ARM_COLLAPSED is trusted.
preconditions.control: scripted action cycle, seed=7, 60 steps, no agent/arm involved

preconditions.name: genuine_benefit_channel_reachable
preconditions.description: A scripted movement sequence must produce at least one tick where genuine (unmanipulated) benefit_exposure alone -- at zero drive, the pessimistic case -- clears GoalConfig.benefit_threshold, so that ARM_SEPARATED's observed goal_weighted-active fraction is CONTINGENT on real resource contact rather than arithmetically impossible regardless of behaviour (symmetric to harm_relief_channel_reachable).
preconditions.control: scripted action cycle, seed=13, 200 steps, no agent/arm involved, zero-drive multiplier

preconditions.name: goal_valuation_readout_reachable
preconditions.description: With z_goal forced active via a direct saturating update_z_goal call (benefit_exposure=1.0, drive_level=1.0), a direct agent.e3.select(..., goal_state=agent.goal_state) call must show |goal_weighted| > EPSILON -- confirming the readout mechanism itself responds to an active z_goal, independent of any organic arm/seed behaviour (C1 tests organic engagement separately).
preconditions.control: scripted force-saturated update_z_goal call, seed=17, no organic play
